create_TensorDict_from_dict: create a TensorDict from a nested dictionary of torch tensors using from_tree
flatten_TensorDict_to_leaves: flatten a TensorDict into a list of key tuples and leaf tensors using flatten
map_function_across_TensorDict: apply a transformation function to all leaf tensors in a TensorDict using map
index_TensorDict_with_tensor: index a TensorDict with a tensor index to slice all leaf tensors at once
transpose_list_of_dicts: transpose a list of dictionaries into a dictionary of lists using transpose_list_of_dicts
